design_origin: common native acceleration after negative v16 scan pilots
hypothesis: strict ball arithmetic can remove interval overhead while preserving exact decisions
limitations: first stage has no changed ancestors
C4 is a bounded shard-zero prefix, not the scientific four-shard frame
single in-process timings have uncontrolled cache and machine activity
all failed variants and registered pass limits remain reported
solver timings exclude complete state and prior-state loading
software tests are separate from empirical worker CPU accounting
Native warm candidates only change grid-cell search; they do not avoid accumulator work.
Fast shared kernels do not establish full-model repair benefit.
one_process_order: dataset order as listed; sequential original and retained references before alternating speculative pairs
